common_provider_model.rationale: Both Pi and ClineMM ship a built-in MiniMax provider (Pi: provider id 'MiniMax' using MINIMAX_API_KEY; ClineMM: provider id 'minimax' using MINIMAX_API_KEY with baseURL https://api.minimax.io/anthropic/v1). The user's local secrets store contains a MiniMax API key. The model id MiniMax-M3 is reported verbatim by both harnesses' provider/model identity fields. This is the only provider/model combination both candidates support natively.
common_provider_model.probe_evidence_pi: Pi --mode json -p 'say hello' emitted message_end with provider='minimax', model='MiniMax-M3', api='anthropic-messages'.
